pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, dark brown contiguous regions exhibiting smooth to moderately angular edge gradients; larger spatial area patches are concentrated on the central flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes toward the extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-colored pathways forming a complex topological graph with frequent 3-way and 4-way junction nodes; corridor width is relatively uniform, maintaining clear pixel-level separation between dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, stiff mane hairs create a fine-grained, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper cervical ridge and shoulder line.
